pairs: Factum est autem in diebus illis,
Now it happened that, in those days,
the Philistines gathered together their troops,
ut præpararentur ad bellum contra Israël:
so that they might be prepared for war against Israel.
Sciens nunc scito quoniam mecum egredieris in castris,
“I know now, certainly, that you will go out with me to war,
Nunc scies quæ facturus est servus tuus.
“You know now what your servant will do.”
Et ego custodem capitis mei ponam te cunctis diebus.
“And so, I will appoint you to guard my head for all days.”
and all of Israel mourned for him,
et sepelierunt eum in Ramatha urbe sua.
and they buried him in Ramah,
And Saul took away the magi and soothsayers from the land.
congregavit autem et Saul universum Israël,
Then Saul also gathered all of Israel,
And Saul saw the camp of the Philistines,
and his heart was exceedingly terrified.
But he did not respond to him,
And Saul said to his servants,
“Seek for me a woman having a divining spirit,
and I will go to her,
Et dixerunt servi ejus ad eum:
And his servants said to him,
Est mulier pythonem habens in Endor.
“There is a woman having a divining spirit at Endor.”
Therefore, he changed his usual appearance,
and he put on other clothes. And he went,
et duo viri cum eo: veneruntque ad mulierem nocte,
and they came to the woman by night. And he said to her,
et suscita mihi quem dixero tibi.
and raise up for me whomever I will tell you.”
And the woman said to him:
you know how much Saul has done,
et quomodo eraserit magos et hariolos de terra:
and how he has wiped away the magi and soothsayers from the land.
Why then do you set a trap for my life,
so that it will be put to death?”
Et juravit ei Saul in Domino,
And Saul swore to her by the Lord,
quia non eveniet tibi quidquam mali propter hanc rem.
nothing evil will befall you because of this matter.”
And the woman said to him,
“Whom shall I raise up for you?”
And when the woman had seen Samuel,
she cried out with a loud voice,
And the king said to her:
And the woman said to Saul,
“I saw gods ascending from the earth.”
and he is clothed in a cloak.”
Et intellexit Saul quod Samuel esset,
And Saul understood that it was Samuel.
et inclinavit se super faciem suam in terra,
And he bowed himself upon his face on the ground,
“Why have you disquieted me, so that I would be raised up?”
Coarctor nimis: siquidem Philisthiim pugnant adversum me,
“I am greatly distressed. For the Philistines fight against me,
and God has withdrawn from me,
et exaudire me noluit neque in manu prophetarum,
and he is not willing to heed me, neither by the hand of prophets,
so that you would reveal to me what I should do.”
though the Lord has withdrawn from you,
and has crossed over to your rival?
Faciet enim tibi Dominus sicut locutus est in manu mea,
For the Lord will do to you just as he spoke by my hand.
et scindet regnum tuum de manu tua
And he will tear your kingdom from your hand.
et dabit illud proximo tuo David:
And he will give it to your neighbor David.
For you did not obey the voice of the Lord,
neque fecisti iram furoris ejus in Amalec:
and you did not carry out the wrath of his fury upon Amalek.
the Lord has done to you what you are enduring this day.
Et dabit Dominus etiam Israël tecum in manus Philisthiim:
And the Lord also will give Israel into the hands of the Philistines, along with you.
cras autem tu et filii tui mecum eritis:
Then tomorrow you and your sons will be with me.
sed et castra Israël tradet Dominus in manus Philisthiim.
But the Lord will also deliver the camp of Israel into the hands of the Philistines.”
Statimque Saul cecidit porrectus in terram:
And immediately, Saul fell stretched out on the ground.
For he was terrified by the words of Samuel.
et robur non erat in eo,
And there was no strength in him.
quia non comederat panem tota die illa.
For he had not eaten bread all that day.
Ingressa est itaque mulier illa ad Saul (conturbatus enim erat valde),
And so, the woman entered to Saul, (for he was very troubled) and she said to him:
dixitque ad eum: Ecce obedivit ancilla tua voci tuæ,
“Behold, your handmaid has obeyed your voice,
et posui animam meam in manu mea:
and I have placed my life in my hand.
et audivi sermones tuos, quos locutus es ad me.
And I have heeded the words which you spoke to me.
Nunc igitur audi et tu vocem ancillæ tuæ,
And so now, I ask you to heed the voice of your handmaid,
et ponam coram te buccellam panis,
and let me place before you a morsel of bread, so that,
by eating, you may recover strength,
and you may be able to undertake the journey.”
Coëgerunt autem eum servi sui et mulier,
But his servants and the woman urged him,
et tandem audita voce eorum surrexit de terra,
and after some time, heeding their voice, he rose up from the ground,
and he sat upon the bed.
Mulier autem illa habebat vitulum pascualem in domo,
Now the woman had a fatted calf in the house,
et posuit ante Saul et ante servos ejus.
And she set it before Saul and before his servants.
et ambulaverunt per totam noctem illam.
and they walked all through that night.
